params.name: from
params.description: Fetch Payment Intents created after this date-time

params.name: to
params.description: Fetch Payment Intents created before this date-time

params.name: status
params.description: Filter the results to a specific status

items.docs: The Payment intent is the contract between your backend and Lean to certify that you will request a payment from your customer of a specified amount and currency. In order to initiate a payment, the `payment_intent_id` must be provided into the `pay()` method of the LinkSDK.
